description: Defines classes and interfaces for F1-U split gateway and bearer management, including GTP-U adapters, demux, and session handling within the ocudu::odu namespace.

classes.name: gtpu_tx_udp_gw_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for GTP-U to pass PDUs to the IO gateway, implements upper layer notifier.

classes.name: gtpu_rx_f1u_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for GTP-U to pass SDUs (NR-U messages) into the lower layer, implements NR-U RX notifier.

classes.name: network_gateway_data_gtpu_demux_adapter
classes.description: Adapter between Network Gateway data and GTP-U demux, handles PDU forwarding.

classes.name: f1u_split_gateway_du_bearer
classes.description: Represents a bearer at the CU F1-U gateway, manages GTP-U tunnels and SDU handling.

classes.name: f1u_split_connector
classes.description: Connects DU and CU-UP F1-U bearers, manages bearer creation/removal and session mapping.

methods.name: on_new_pdu
methods.description: Handles new PDU received by GTP-U adapter, forwards to handler.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects the adapter to a handler.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the adapter from its handler.

methods.name: on_new_sdu
methods.description: Handles new SDU (NR-U message) received by GTP-U adapter.

methods.name: connect_gtpu_demux
methods.description: Connects the demux interface to the adapter.

methods.name: get_bind_address
methods.description: Returns the bind address for the bearer.

methods.name: get_tunnel_rx_interface
methods.description: Returns the receive interface of the GTP-U tunnel.

methods.name: create_du_bearer
methods.description: Creates a new DU bearer with specified parameters.

methods.name: remove_du_bearer
methods.description: Removes a DU bearer based on transport layer info.

methods.name: get_du_bind_address
methods.description: Retrieves the bind address for a specific gNB DU ID.
